changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment:
Removes the two quota tables from 016-ebay-quota.xml. The price lookup they served (ADR-0017) ran in production and was then withdrawn as not good enough (TODO-56); a dashboard search link replaced it (TODO-57), which needs no budget and therefore no counter.
(Corrected on 2026-09-09: this comment previously claimed the developer account had never been granted and the lookup had never run. Both were wrong. Safe to edit -- Liquibase computes a changeset's checksum without its comment, verified by rerunning an already-migrated database against a changed comment.)
A new changeset rather than an edit of 016: applied changesets are immutable, and rewriting one would leave every database that already ran it with tables Liquibase believes it never created.
The unique constraint on ebay_user_quota_day needs no separate drop -- it goes with its table -- and there is no foreign key from anywhere else, so the order of the two drops is free. They are still written child-before-parent, which is the order that stays correct if a reference is ever added between writing this and running it.
017-user-ebay-marketplace.xml is deliberately untouched: app_user.ebay_marketplace carries the marketplace setting, which survives the rollback and feeds the search link.
This discards the recorded call counts. They have no reader left and no value without the feature -- but the deletion is real and one-way, and the branch that preserves the code (feature/ebay_search) does not preserve data.
